about: The Preface of the Apostles. It asks the eternal Shepherd not to forsake His flock, but to preserve it under the protection of the Apostles and their successors.

seg.nr: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

seg.tr: Truly it is right and just, fitting and leading to salvation:
To entreat You humbly, O Lord, that You, eternal Shepherd, would not forsake Your flock, but through Your blessed Apostles would keep it under constant protection:
That it may be governed by those same rulers whom You appointed over it as pastors and vicars of Your work.
And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominions, and with all the host of the heavenly army, we sing the hymn of Your glory, evermore saying:
